stem.text: Which statement about tissue fluid formation is correct?

A.text: The hydrostatic pressure of blood decreases from the arteriole end to the venule end of a capillary.

B.text: The water potential is always higher in the blood in the capillaries than in the tissue fluid in the surrounding tissues.

C.text: No cells move out of the blood in the capillaries into the tissue fluid.

D.text: Most tissue fluid formation occurs at the venule end of a capillary.
